payload.claim: The refusal check `if not is_follow_up and turn.fault_lines:` fires on any non-empty tuple, but the only witness for an order spec's refusal (`TE-591` in `tests/test_batch.py`) scripts a two-line `fault_lines`. No test drives this path with exactly one fault line for a spec of the order (the single-line case, `TE-595`, is a follow-up and takes the excluded branch). Changing the check to `len(turn.fault_lines) > 1` would still pass every test in this diff while silently letting a revision with one fault line through uncaught, contrary to the acceptance criterion's 'ends with fault_lines' (any non-empty).
